**Plan, not yet applied.**

`buildRows()` in [report.js](src/report.js) already carries full data, `owner` and `slow` included. `toTable()` in [format.js](src/format.js) drops those on purpose for width reasons.

1. Add `--json` parsing in [cli.js](src/cli.js).
2. On that flag, `JSON.stringify(buildRows())` instead of `toTable`.
3. No changes needed to `report.js` or `format.js`.

Next: say go and I'll make the edit.
